title: More ways to choose and use models
summary:
New model options, a persistent computer for agents, and direct account controls made this a busy day for both generation and the tools around it.

DeepSeek V4.1 Flash was added with reasoning, tool calling, image input, and a 1,048,576-token context window. MiniMax H3 Max Turbo gained 1080p video at its existing durations. Generation requests can now list up to four models as an ordered fallback chain. Community models adopted `community/owner/model` as their catalog and API-key permission ID; the previous `owner/model` form remains a generation alias.

Computer MCP adds a private, persistent filesystem and bash tool for agents. Prompt agents can now take up to 24 steps and make 48 tool calls, while code agents have more execution headroom. Tool results and failures are easier for clients to handle, including across chat turns. Floret also gained typed media response blocks and optional terminal stream usage.

New standalone top-up and API-key editor pages give in-chat payment notices a useful destination. Low-balance notices point to wallet top-up; exhausted key-budget notices point to the relevant key editor and clarify that adding wallet funds does not raise a key budget. The pages also offer a link back to the app after checkout.

daily.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash added
daily.text: Try `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash` for reasoning and tool calling, with text and image input and a 1,048,576-token context window. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash).

daily.title: MiniMax video at 1080p
daily.text: Generate 1080p video with MiniMax H3 Max Turbo from text or first and last frames, at its existing 5-, 10-, and 15-second durations. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Bring your own fallbacks
daily.text: List up to four comma-separated models in a generation request. If one fails after its provider routes are tried, the next model gets a turn. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: A persistent computer for agents
daily.text: Computer MCP gives your agents a private filesystem that persists between runs, plus bash for working with files and repositories. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Top up from chat
daily.text: Payment notices in chat now link to a standalone wallet top-up or the relevant API-key editor, depending on what needs attention. Both pages offer a link back to your app.

daily.title: Community model IDs clarified
daily.text: Community models now use `community/owner/model` in the catalog and when creating or updating API-key permissions. Existing `owner/model` names still work for generation. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Typed media from Floret
daily.text: Floret chat responses now include ordered, typed media in `message.content_blocks` alongside Markdown in `message.content`. Streams can also include a terminal usage chunk when `stream_options.include_usage` is true. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
